home.heroBody: One corporate identity bringing together the companies, business units, and partners of the Citramas group.
home.introBody: Citramas Corporate Group brings companies with different sectors, brands, and expertise together in one business ecosystem. PT Citramas Alfa Sejahtera serves as the group's head office.
home.introNote: Each company keeps its own profile, services, clients, and achievements. Group-level and company-level information are presented separately.
home.historyBody: Other group milestones will be published once their years and events are verified.
home.companiesBody: The head office and the companies within the group, each with an independent profile.
home.areasBody: The sectors operated by the companies in the group. Each area links to the related companies.
home.brandsBody: Brands are shown with the company that owns them — never claimed for the group as a whole.
home.clientsBody: Clients are recorded under the company that serves them.
home.newsEmpty: Group and company news will appear here.
home.contactBody: For corporate, partnership, and media enquiries, contact the Citramas Corporate Group head office.

about.title: About Us
about.lead: Citramas Corporate Group is the corporate identity that brings together the head office, companies, business units, and partners of the Citramas group.
about.roleBody: PT Citramas Alfa Sejahtera serves as the group's head office. Its full company profile is available on its own profile page.
about.relationshipsBody: Not every company in the directory is a legal subsidiary. Each company is given the appropriate relationship type, and relationships are only published as fact once verified.
about.visionBody: The group's vision and mission statements will be published once approved by management.
